policy: shadow first: a witness's verdicts are observe-only until its trial holds; a disagreement triggers REC (a changed licence or frame), never a retry; every entry carries the control that would falsify it

trials.control: a series from a declared linear system (x_{t+1} = A x_t with published eigenvalues), plus a shuffled null of the same series (seeded Fisher-Yates)
trials.reads: eigenvalue multiset agreement at the declared tolerance (EIGEN_AGREEMENT_TOL); the real series must agree, the shuffled null must not
trials.falsifying: the shuffled null matching at the same rate as the real series (the witness reads noise), or the real series failing its declared eigenvalues in EITHER engine

trials.witness_against: the suite's own coverage of the guard's entry point
trials.control: a mutated entry point must be caught by the suite; the control is the same suite on the unmutated entry (a surviving mutant means the guard was never reached)
trials.reads: mutants killed / produced on the named entry; the control run must be green before any mutant verdict counts
trials.falsifying: a surviving mutant on the entry function the guard names — the guard named a check it never ran
trials.runner: not wired (needs FOLD_CUBE traffic against python code; step 5)

trials.witness_against: derive's transitive withdrawal (the licensed composition organ)
trials.control: premises as #external atoms; withdrawing one premise must retract exactly the products derive retracts on the same premise set — no more, no fewer
trials.reads: the retracted set, both engines, same premises; set equality is the finding
trials.falsifying: clingo retracting fewer or more products than derive's own transitive withdrawal — the two named derivations disagree about what an withdrawn premise carried
